## Technical reference

- [Main CPU base, OM-5 1.2](../reference/om5-1200.main-cpu-base.md): Runtime address = decoded block 0 offset + 0x60021020, the OM-3's base, not the E-P7's.
- [Half-press (S1) event hook site, OM-5 1.2](../reference/om5-1200.s1-hook.md): The E-P7 SD-loader trigger call, byte-identical apart from its displacement; a 5-byte call in section 1.
- [Section 1 loaded tail, OM-5 1.2](../reference/om5-1200.section-1-loaded-tail.md): 0x138 bytes of 0xFF before section 1's loaded end; the larger free run past that end is not copied to RAM.
- [Section 8 loaded tail, OM-5 1.2](../reference/om5-1200.section-8-loaded-tail.md): 0x7b8 bytes of 0xFF before section 8's loaded end; section 8 is copied second, after section 0.
